tex_content.label: corI.8.3
tex_content.html: Let $(M,g(t)),\ a\le t\le b$, be a Ricci flow with $(M,g(t))$ complete for every $t \in [0,T)$. Fix a positive function $K(t)$, and suppose that $\Ric _{g(t)}(x,t)\le (n-1)K(t)$ for all $x\in M$ and all $t\in [a,b]$. Let $x_0,x_1$ be two points of $M$. Then \[ d_a(x_0,x_1)\le d_b(x_0,x_1)+4(n-1)\int _a^b\sqrt{\frac{2K(t)}{3}}dt. \]
